findings.detail: Alloy Technologies interest_rate was captured as the 5.00% EOT payment instead of the stated Prime + 5.25% interest term with a 13.75% floor.

citation.quoted_text: Alloy Technologies, Inc. | Growth Capital Loan (Prime + 5.25 % interest rate, 13.75 % floor, 5.00 % EOT payment) | 8/8/2024 | 1,057 | 1,083 | 1,083 | 8/31/2027

rationale: The bundle's holdings slice shows Alloy Technologies, Inc. Growth Capital Loan stored with interest_rate 5.0. The raw SOI row identifies 5.00% as the EOT payment, while the interest-rate clause is Prime + 5.25% with a 13.75% floor. The stored value is therefore an extraction of the wrong term, not a valid interest rate.
